(3) The scene shifts to the woman in the brown sweater occupying the full frame, speaking with high energy and a furrowed brow; she wears black-rimmed glasses and a white collared shirt underneath her sweater. (5) The video concludes with a static graphic background featuring clinic contact information, logos, and location addresses in a clean professional layout.
